# Kings'n Queens Caffetteria

> Da fazenda para sua casa. Kings'n Queens sells Café Dona Irani in Paraguay: coffee grown, harvested and roasted on Fazenda Dona Irani in Gália, São Paulo, Brazil. Orders are confirmed on WhatsApp.

The site is available in Spanish, English and Portuguese. Prices are reference prices in guaraníes and subject to confirmation.

## Coffees

- [Gourmet, whole bean, 1 kg](https://www.kingsnqueens.com.py/#p-gourmet): 100% Mundo Novo Arabica, selectively harvested, light roast.
- [Superior, whole bean, 1 kg](https://www.kingsnqueens.com.py/#p-superior): selected Arabica, medium roast.
- [Tradicional, ground, 500 g](https://www.kingsnqueens.com.py/#p-tradicional): 100% Arabica, dark roast.

## About

- [The farm](https://www.kingsnqueens.com.py/#finca): history since 1936, 108 hectares of Atlantic Forest, varieties and harvest calendar.
- [The journey](https://www.kingsnqueens.com.py/#recorrido): every stage from the farm to the buyer's home.
- [How the grading works](https://www.kingsnqueens.com.py/#clasificacion): the three ABIC quality tiers.
